data.one_liner: Material Design charting library for Flutter, forked from google/charts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of chart widgets such as line, bar, pie, and combo charts. It is written in pure Dart and supports null safety. The library follows Material Design guidelines for appearance and interaction.
use_when: You need a Material Design compliant chart library for Flutter.
You want a variety of chart types without external dependencies.
You prefer a library that is already null‑safe and works on all Flutter platforms.
avoid_when: You require community contributions or frequent updates.
You need extensive documentation or examples beyond the basic gallery.
You are looking for a chart library that integrates with a specific state‑management solution.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation, no native code required.
Supports all Flutter platforms (mobile, web, desktop).
Provides a wide range of chart types and customization options.
Fully null‑safe and follows Flutter best practices.
weaknesses: No external contributions allowed, limiting community support.
Documentation is minimal and relies on the online gallery.
Not actively maintained; last release was 1.0.4.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Popular, actively maintained, extensive examples and documentation.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature‑rich, commercial license available, supports many chart types.

alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight graph library for simple visualizations.
